# Yip (yip.lt)

> Žmogaus patikrinti pigūs skrydžiai iš Vilniaus, Kauno ir Rygos. Randam, patikrinam ir pasakom, kodėl verta ir koks kabliukas. Bilietą perki tiesiogiai iš aviakompanijos.

Yip is a Lithuanian-language flight-deal letter for the Baltics. We scan routes from Vilnius (VNO), Kaunas (KUN) and Riga (RIX) daily, check every find by hand, and publish a few finds a week. Prices are shown as found and re-verified daily; expired finds stay online as proof, marked as past.

## Pages
- https://yip.lt/ — the current edition of finds
- https://yip.lt/rinkiniai — finds by origin city and travel moment
- https://yip.lt/pigus-skrydziai-is-vilniaus — cheap flights from Vilnius
- https://yip.lt/pigus-skrydziai-is-kauno — cheap flights from Kaunas
- https://yip.lt/pigus-skrydziai-is-rygos — cheap flights from Riga
- https://yip.lt/buvo — past finds (expired, kept as a record)
- https://yip.lt/privatumas — privacy

## Facts
- Language: Lithuanian. Origins: VNO, KUN, RIX. Currency: EUR.
- We never sell tickets; every find links to the airline or Google Flights.
- Contact: hello@yip.lt
